id: \rAre you \PN? I was watching you during the Alola League.

id: \rI'm impressed. Keep up the hard work!
en: \rI'm impressed. Keep up the hard work!

id: \bI will continue to hone my skills as a magician.

en: \bDo you know who I am? I was meant to be famous.
